title: Hot Vanilla Malted Milk with Cinnamon
summary: A warm, creamy drink of malted milk and brown sugar sweetened with vanilla, topped with a cloud of frothy foam and dusted with cinnamon.

ingredients.item: vanilla pod, split and seeds scraped

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Put 960 ml whole milk in a medium saucepan with 1 vanilla pod (split and seeds scraped). Warm over medium heat until it steams, without boiling.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk in 85 g malted milk powder and 50 g light brown sugar until dissolved, then remove the pod.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Carefully blend about 240 ml of the hot milk in the blender (lid vented, covered with a cloth) until very frothy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour the plain malted milk into 4 mugs, spoon the foam on top and dust with ½ tsp ground cinnamon.

tips: When blending hot liquid, fill the blender no more than a third full and vent the lid to avoid splashing.
Malted milk powder contains gluten (barley and wheat); avoid if coeliac or gluten-sensitive.
storage: Serve immediately whilst hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
